name: TFM2 Patch Balance Improvement
summary: Caps full patch-note champion count through the rebalancer and neutralizes action patch fields to prevent mixed-direction cards.
notes: When tfm2_patch_rebalancer is enabled, tracked stat/growth champions are capped per full patch event: weak=4, normal=6, strong=8.
Same-champion mixed stat/growth directions now keep the dominant magnitude direction and revert the other side.
All action patch fields are locked to 1.0..1.0 because the public native SDK does not expose stable action setters.
